AssignmentsPageInner.leComboSeraLibereEt: The combo will be released and can be reassigned to the creator on the same platform. This can't be undone.
AssignmentsPageInner.texteAIncrusterEnHaut: Text to overlay at the top of the video
AssignmentsPageInner.unAssignmentPublieOuPaye: A published or paid assignment can't be deleted.
AssignmentsPageInner.aDejaEteRelanceIl: {creatorName} was already nudged less than 24h ago.
AssignmentsPageInner.assignmentSupprimeLeComboEst: Assignment deleted — the combo is available again.

AccountCheckLine.lienRaccourciCompteNonVerifiable: Shortened link — account can't be checked here.
AccountCheckLine.compteNonPresentDansL: Account not in the URL — can't be checked.

AdminPublishForm.normalementLaCreatriceColleLe: Normally the creator pastes the link from their space. As a backup, you can paste it here — same effect (published, view tracking).
AdminPublishForm.cetteVideoNEstPas: ⚠️ This video isn't marked as ready. Entering the link moves it straight to
AdminPublishForm.parDefautAujourdHuiCorrige: Defaults to today. Correct it if the post went out earlier (the pay anchor follows the actual date, not the entry).
AdminPublishForm.normalSiTuRegularisesUn: Normal if you're regularizing a post published outside the app. The actual date is kept as is.
AdminPublishForm.publierALaPlaceDe: Publish on behalf of the creator
AdminPublishForm.colleLUrlDuPost: Paste the post's URL for each platform.
AdminPublishForm.publieLaCreatriceVoitLe: Published — the creator sees the post and its performance.

AssignmentDetailSheet.leComboSeraLibereEt: The combo will be released and can be reassigned. This can't be undone.
AssignmentDetailSheet.pasDeScriptMontePour: No script assembled for this assignment.
AssignmentDetailSheet.assignationPublieeOuPayeeSuppression: Assignment published or paid — delete unavailable (the financial history is kept).
AssignmentDetailSheet.laVideoDejaSoumiseSera: The video already submitted will be discarded for good.
AssignmentDetailSheet.assignationSupprimeeLeComboEst: Assignment deleted — the combo is available again.

CorrectUrlButton.aUtiliserQuandLaCreatrice: Use this when the creator pasted the link of ANOTHER video. The view readings collected on the old video will be erased — tracking restarts from zero on the right one. The publish date and pay cycle don't move.
CorrectUrlButton.lienCorrigeReleveDeL: Link fixed — {deletedSnapshots} {deletedSnapshots, plural, one {reading} other {readings}} from the old video erased.

AssignmentInstructionsDialog.consigneLibreAfficheeDansLe: Free-form note shown in {creatorName}'s brief (e.g. “shoot outdoors”, “push the hook in the first 2 seconds”). Specific to this assignment. Leave empty to show no block at all.
AssignmentInstructionsDialog.visibleParLaCreatriceDans: {count}/{INSTRUCTIONS_MAX} — visible to the creator in their brief, separate from the script.
AssignmentInstructionsDialog.exReprendsLaVideoModele: E.g.: redo the model video but shorter, put the product at the end.

AssignmentModelVideosDialog.desLiensVersDesVideos: LINKS to existing videos to recreate with the script. The creator sees them in their brief as “videos to recreate”.

AssignmentOverlayDialog.texteAIncrusterEnHaut: Text to overlay at the top of the video
AssignmentOverlayDialog.consignePourOverlayPermanentAffiche: Note for {creatorName} — permanent overlay shown above the hook. Leave empty to overlay nothing.
AssignmentOverlayDialog.apparaitEnHautDeLa: {count}/{OVERLAY_MAX} — appears at the top of the video, above the hook on the creator's side.

AssignmentPostDateDialog.leJourOuCetteVideo: The day this video should go out. Different from the production due date.

AssignmentScriptDialog.scriptIndisponibleIlAPu: Script unavailable — it may have been removed since.

AssignmentsCalendar.sansDate: {total} {total, plural, one {deliverable} other {deliverables}} with no publish date {total, plural, one {isn't} other {aren't}} in any of these counters{aFaire, plural, =0 {} other { — including {aFaire} not published yet, so invisible on the calendar}}.
AssignmentsCalendar.visibleCount: {count} {count, plural, one {post} other {posts}} {status} shown (filters applied). Assignments with no publish date don't appear.

EditBrickTextDialog.modifieLeTexteDUne: Change a brick's text. This creates a NEW variant in the library (same type + tier) and applies it to this assignment. One edit only, before publishing. Pricing isn't affected.
EditBrickTextDialog.texteEditeNouvelleVarianteCreee: Text edited — new variant created, script updated.

EditScriptComboDialog.remplaceUneBriqueHookFlux: Replace ONE brick (hook, flow or description). One fix only, before publishing. Pricing isn't affected.
EditScriptComboDialog.aucuneAutreBriqueActiveDans: No other “{value}” brick active in the campaign.

ImposedComboBadge.combinaisonImposeeManuellementRejeuOu: Combination enforced manually (replay or choice), outside the automatic draw.

LinkAssetFolderDialog.lieUnOuPlusieursDossiers: Link one or more folders to this assignment. The creator can download their files from their brief.
LinkAssetFolderDialog.aucunDossierDAssetsCrees: No asset folder — create one in Assets.
